name: riplexa-vs-timestamp
description: Shows the real time on every message, reply and tool call inside the Claude Code chat panel — inline on the text line, start→result on tools.

commands.title: Riplexa VS Timestamp: Disable (restore original Claude Code panel)

riplexaVsTimestamp.enabled.markdownDescription: Show real timestamps in the Claude Code chat panel. Turning this off restores Claude Code's original panel file (reload the window afterwards).

riplexaVsTimestamp.showStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show the **Timestamp: On/Off** toggle in the status bar.

riplexaVsTimestamp.userMessageColor.markdownDescription: Text color of **your own messages** in the Claude Code chat panel, as a CSS color — e.g. `#90EE90`, `lightgreen`, `rgb(144,238,144)`. Leave empty to keep Claude Code's color. Takes effect after the panel reloads.
